decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the east elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east or west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8.00 a.m.  to  6.00 p.m. on Mondays to Friday and 9.30 a.m.  to 12.30 p.m. on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The door to the office shall be obscured glazing or other obscured material and thereafter permanently maintained in such material.

Condition : 8 - The development shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours from the extended restaurant, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the local planning authority in writing.
description: Erection of a 3 storey rear extension, basement & ground floors to be used as an extension to existing restaurant. First floor to be used as a self contained office with access from rear and alterations to staircase (changed to spiral)
